title: Jalapeño-Lime Chicken Salad with Coriander
changes_from_base: Pickled jalapeños, lime and coriander replace the soured cream, tarragon and parsley; red pepper and red onion add colour.
summary: A zippy chicken salad with chopped pickled jalapeños, lime mayonnaise, red pepper, red onion and coriander.

steps.title: Cook and cool the chicken
steps.text: Put the breasts and bay leaf into cold water in a pan, bring to the barest simmer, cover and remove from the heat. Check after 15 min for 74 °C, then lift out, cool and chop finely.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise with the lime juice.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the jalapeños, pepper, onion, celery, coriander and black pepper, then fold in the lime mayonnaise. Taste before adding salt; the pickled chillies are salty. Chill 20 min.

tips: Taste before salting; the pickled jalapeños bring salt.
Chop the vegetables fine so every bite has crunch.
Spoon into tortillas or onto tostadas.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
